verdict.rationale: Clara documents its own accounts-payable surface: the API covers processing invoices, and an AP payment endpoint (`POST /api/v3/accounts-payable/pix`) moves money to payees. The evidence shows only Pix as a payment rail. The approvals mentioned in the docs concern expense reporting, not AP invoice routing. missing for 10: invoice capture details (OCR/inbox), AP approval routing, vendor payment by ACH, check, or wire, independent or hands-on corroboration.
